answer: Night assay rights attach to one drawer, never a reused login. I stake 27.6 POA on bench CB-14 for 41 min and cut a 9.4 ct fire opal into a 14x10 mm cabochon. A 0.4 mm stylus must wander an 11-station grid, logging crown height (3.1-3.4 mm) every 8 s. Stone and a 7 mm wax seal go into vault drawer V-19, then welded shut. Peers reweigh to 0.02 ct and recheck stations 4 and 9. A second CB-14 booking, or grid RMSE within 0.12 mm of another ticket, slashes 58 percent and seals CB-14. If humidity tops 62 percent before station 7, work freezes 14 h; a new drawer is required, never the same wax seal.
